text: Use default browser styling for buttons, inputs, and links
Use grid lines, tables with visible borders, and stark boundaries instead of whitespace to separate content
Use high contrast colors for links and accents (e.g. #0000FF blue, #FF0000 red)
Use system fonts like Courier New, Times New Roman, or Comic Sans; avoid web fonts
Set body background-color: #ffffff, color: #000000, font-family: monospace
Add border: 1px solid #000 to .brutalist-container
Add border-bottom: 2px dashed #000, margin-bottom: 20px, padding-bottom: 20px to .brutalist-section
Create .brutalist-btn with specific styles: background-color, border, colors, font, padding, cursor
Set .brutalist-btn:active with border-style: inset
Set link color: #0000FF with text-decoration: underline
Use harsh, high-contrast borders (1px solid black) around everything
Avoid border-radius, drop shadows, or smooth transitions; if it animates, it should pop instantly (0s transition)
Avoid all native ButtonStyle components in SwiftUI
Use .border(Color.black, width: 1) instead of backgrounds or shadows in SwiftUI
Force monospace fonts like Courier New or Menlo in SwiftUI
Use VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 0) in SwiftUI
Add Text with .font(.custom("Courier New", size: 32)), .foregroundColor(.black), .padding(10), .border(Color.black, width: 2) in SwiftUI
Add Divider().background(Color.black).padding(.vertical, 20) in SwiftUI
Add Button with Text("CLICK_HERE") and .font(.custom("Courier New", size: 24)), .foregroundColor(.blue), .underline(), .padding(10) in SwiftUI

Use .border(Color.black, width: 1) instead of backgrounds or shadows in SwiftUI (repeated directive)

Avoid ElevatedButton, Card, or AppBar in Flutter
Build UI out of raw Containers with Border.all(color: Colors.black) and Text widgets in Flutter
Use TextDecoration.underline to indicate interactivity in Flutter
Use pure hex colors: #FFFFFF, #000000, #0000FF in Flutter
Set borderWidth: 2, borderColor: "#000000", padding: 10, alignSelf: "flex-start" in React Native
Set fontFamily: "monospace", fontSize: 32, color: "#000" in React Native
Add View with height: 2, backgroundColor: "#000", marginVertical: 20 in React Native
Use textDecorationLine: "underline" for interactivity in React Native
Set activeOpacity={1} on TouchableOpacity so there is no smooth fade (instant click) in React Native
Use pure hex colors: #FFFFFF, #000000, #0000FF in React Native
Use BasicText instead of Text to bypass Material theme defaults in Jetpack Compose
Build structural lines using Box with .background(Color.Black) in Jetpack Compose
Do not use Button or Card or any Material composables; use raw layouts only in Jetpack Compose
Use modifier .border(2.dp, Color.Black).padding(10.dp) in Jetpack Compose
Use Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp)) for vertical spacing in Jetpack Compose
Do NOT use border-radius, drop shadows, or smooth transitions
Raw materials exposed. An intentional rejection of polish, gradients, and soft shadows.
Use this sub-style when the user's request matches the aesthetic described above.

Industrial Chic palette fits best for the color scheme.
Dithered images, pixelated graphics, or heavily compressed jpegs for visual style.
Pure `#0000FF` blue for links, `#FF0000` red for accents, on stark white or `#C0C0C0` grey backgrounds.
Courier New, Times New Roman, Comic Sans, or default sans-serifs; no web fonts.
